title: Faster iPhone workspaces and Account Upgrades
items: The updated iPhone app saves its app files for faster reopening, checks for updates, and keeps Vision, Venture and Vortex ready when you switch between them.

Request an Account Upgrade from the menu. Admin approval enables Gemini transcription, Luna screenshot descriptions and Luna project titles. Your transcription and description choices apply across all projects.
The title bar stays visible. Compact menus keep app shortcuts together at the bottom, and conversation history uses pages instead of scrolling.
